answer: Trust-flow limits on the agent graph blunt Sybil farms. Rewards follow a max-flow computation from trusted seed agents, so an identity can only receive as much trust as passes through the few real edges linking it to honest peers. A farm may spin a spiral of fakes that vouch for each other, but that whisper network sits behind a thin cut; however many names it adds, its total trust stays capped. To grow, the attacker must win genuine links from honest agents, a gale of costly, slow work per edge.
